blocks.label: Block 1 — Univalent
blocks.instructions:
Contact Classification — Block 1Two contact types will appear on the bearing display.
  • Mechanical (solid stripe): click LEFT
  • Biological (diffuse stripe): click RIGHT
  • Respond based on contact type. Contacts usually appear on their expected side but not always.
  • Respond as quickly and accurately as possible.

blocks.label: Block 2 — Bivalent (Reversed)
blocks.instructions:
Contact Classification — Block 2The mapping has reversed.
  • Mechanical (solid stripe): now click RIGHT
  • Biological (diffuse stripe): now click LEFT
  • Use the new mapping. Respond as quickly and accurately as possible.

blocks.label: Block 3 — Bivalent (no feedback)
blocks.instructions:
Contact Classification — Block 3Same reversed mapping: Mechanical → RIGHT, Biological → LEFT.
  • No feedback this block.
